title: RAG Ground-Truth QA Eval Set
description: Schema for the ground-truth question-answer pairs used to evaluate retrieval and generation quality. Minimum 50 entries required before running retrieval-evaluator or generation-evaluator.

id.description: Unique identifier for this QA pair. Use format: qa-{NNN}

question.description: A natural language question answerable from the corpus. Should be specific, not vague.
examples: What was the total healthcare expenditure in Singapore in 2022?
Which age group had the highest diabetes prevalence in 2021?

answer.description: The correct, complete answer to the question. Must be grounded in the corpus — do not paraphrase or add external knowledge.
examples: Singapore's total healthcare expenditure in 2022 was SGD 27.7 billion, representing 4.1% of GDP.

source_doc_ids.description: List of doc_id values (from ingestion_manifest.csv) that contain the answer. Used to compute retrieval recall. At least one required.

source_page_or_section.description: Optional. Human-readable reference to where in the source document the answer appears. Helps with debugging retrieval failures.

difficulty.description: Optional. Subjective difficulty of the question. Helps identify whether failures cluster by difficulty.

question_type.description: Optional. Type of reasoning required. Helps identify failure patterns by question type.

notes.description: Optional. Any notes for the evaluator — e.g., known ambiguity, multiple valid answers, recency sensitivity.
examples: Answer may vary by year — ensure retrieved context is from 2022 specifically.

examples.question: What was the hospital bed-to-population ratio in Singapore in 2022?
examples.answer: Singapore had approximately 2.4 hospital beds per 1,000 population in 2022.

examples.question: How did diabetes prevalence in Singapore change between 2010 and 2020?
examples.answer: Diabetes prevalence in Singapore increased from 11.3% in 2010 to 13.7% in 2020 among adults aged 18–69.
